projects.title: HealthBridge

projects.title: CodeNova
projects.desc: Built and deployed a full-stack AI coding assistant with a real-time streaming chat interface, agentic tool-calling loop, and per-conversation isolated project workspaces. Features 15 agent tools (file I/O, Python execution, testing, linting, doc search), Supabase Auth/PostgreSQL backend, SSE streaming, and a responsive single-file frontend with markdown rendering. Deployed via Docker on Fly.io with GitHub Actions CI/CD.
projects.summary: An agent that doesn’t just answer. It reads, writes, executes, tests, and debugs code.
projects.problem: Move from a conversational coding assistant to an agent that can work inside isolated project workspaces.
approach: An agentic tool-calling loop with 15 tools for files, execution, testing, linting, and documentation.
Real-time SSE streaming with per-conversation workspace isolation.
Supabase authentication and PostgreSQL, container deployment on Fly.io, and GitHub Actions CI/CD.

Unknown-face enrollment and a thread-safe SQLite WAL engine with background Excel synchronization.

PCA-based feature alignment between PEMS-BAY and METR-LA.
Batch normalization and dropout to help reduce domain shift.
